recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中只見一顆分葉正常、顆粒適中的嗜中性球，紅血球大小稍不一，有少數較大的紅血球；此圖本身缺乏特異性，須結合血球數低下與骨髓發現才能支持 RCC。
features: Single segmented neutrophil with four nuclear lobes and normal-appearing granulation
No obvious hypogranularity or pseudo-Pelger-Huet change in this cell
Red cells with mild anisocytosis, including occasional larger (macrocytic) cells
Paucity of leukocytes and platelets in the field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single segmented neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional macrocytes, without significant poikilocytosis. Leukocytes and platelets appear sparse in this field, although counts cannot be judged from a single high-power field. No blasts or dysplastic granulocytes are identified. Findings are nonspecific; macrocytosis and cytopenias may accompany refractory cytopenia of childhood but require correlation with blood counts and marrow examination.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia can show identical blood findings, and is distinguished by a hypocellular marrow without dysplasia.
Fanconi anemia also presents with macrocytosis and cytopenias and requires chromosomal breakage testing for separation.
Overt MDS with dysgranulopoiesis would show hypogranular or hypolobated neutrophils, which are absent in this cell.
